record.label: Host-uncertainty observable tape augmentation
record.summary: The two-stage aug7 source-information arm is terminal. Stage 1 regenerated the development tape with seven target-free source observables at 688/688 bit-parity against the sealed v3 store. Stage 2, the exact frozen J architecture with only the input widened to 27 raw channels, reached verified OOF final MSE 3.230109930992383e-8 versus J 3.2334958229470984e-8: a 0.1047% improvement with three of four folds improving, 92.01% of gross paired row movement canceling, and the inherited rank-643 breach surviving at 3.3988262727543796e-7. Every aug channel's correlation with per-row gain is at most 0.046 in absolute value, so the added information did not couple to the residual. The gate fails every accuracy conjunct. Q lands within 3.1e-6 relative of N's 3.230119894372402e-8 from a materially different mechanism, consistent with a shared development-frame information ceiling near 3.2301e-8. The preregistered frame-mismatch caveat stands: these channels describe the cp1792 development host's approximation gaps while the target is the Q24 host's error, so this null is ambiguous between a true information cap and wrong-frame channels; the native-frame instance resolves that ambiguity.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed measured for this exact aug7-widened development-frame spelling under its frozen one-arm law: no channel-subset sweep, retune, second checkpoint, meter, or deployment. The sole licensed successor is the design-only native-frame source-uncertainty pilot P2R0F2R, which tests the Q24 host's own discarded-approximation observables against the Q24 host's own error.
